product.scope: Ordinary UART configuration, no BLTouch automatic startup; not the full driver matrix

behavior: Exclusive device session for configured probes and complete grid sampling
Drain ordinary motion before device operations
Rebase after deployment and stow waits to refresh future motion baseline
Native trigger callback schedules stow before recovery
Final homing pass ownership references the generation after device completion
Motion stop also joins probe stop; preparation cancellation grants no axes
limitations: Device PWM/verification mocked in native port tests; split-MCU binding validated separately
Automatic startup and BLTouch configuration selection not connected
No real printer acceptance; Python entrypoint retained
